Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Design and execute wafer-level device reliability test plans for graphene- based photonic devices (DC bias, RF endurance, thermal cycling, long-term stability)

- Identify and investigate the physical mechanisms of graphene-related failure modes.

- Characterize and monitor key performance metrics, including extinction ratio, insertion loss, bandwidth retention, energy efficiency, dark current stability, responsivity degradation over device lifetime

- Drive structured root cause investigations using FMEA/8D methodologies and feed findings back to Design and Process teams

- Work together with product and quality teams to reach compliance with industry standards (JEDEC, OIF, IEC, IEEE) and generate qualification and reliability documentation

Your Qualifications
